easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
